credits.title: The Housemaid
credits.overview: Trying to escape her past, Millie Calloway accepts a job as a live-in housemaid for the wealthy Nina and Andrew Winchester. But what begins as a dream job quickly unravels into something far more dangerous—a sexy, seductive game of secrets, scandal, and power.

credits.title: Another Day in the West
credits.overview: In this comedic love letter to the Western genre, two gunslingers go toe-to-toe over a lady's honor. We learn that gunslingin' it ain't all it's cracked up to be and vicious circle of the West comes to light.

credits.title: The Instigators
credits.overview: Rory and Cobby are unlikely partners thrown together for a heist. But when it goes awry, they team up with an unusual accomplice — Rory's therapist — to outrun police, backward bureaucrats, and a vengeful crime boss.

credits.title: The Desiring
credits.overview: Richard leads a simple life until one day he discovers his wife is having an affair, which unlocks a hidden desire in him. As he secretly watches the affair, he is haunted by memories of his father whose desire for ‘something more’ drove him to suicide.

credits.title: A Place in the Field
credits.overview: Veteran Gio Scuderi receives a package that sends him on a road trip to fulfill a promise and confront his trauma.

credits.overview: When the Primm family moves to New York City, their young son Josh struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. credits.overview: When a seven-year-old boy is sexually abused by his neighbor, he transcends reality into the mystic Wild West where he meets a larger-than-life cowboy who teaches him the art of self-reliance.

credits.title: Mancha
credits.overview: A mother seeks to protect her daughter from the stain that curses her family’s women.

credits.overview: Tony Lip, a bouncer in 1962, is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the Deep South in the days when African Americans, forced to find alternate accommodations and services due to segregation laws below the Mason-Dixon Line, relied on a guide called The Negro Motorist Green Book.

credits.title: Garlic and Gunpowder
credits.overview: Depending on who's talking, a comet is on track to destroy the planet. Sonny and Archie, two Mafia wise guys, plan on stashing their valuables and retiring just in case they survive.

credits.title: Uncle Nick
credits.overview: A drunk uncle attempts to score with his flirtatious step-niece on Christmas Eve.
